title: L0SkillOrchestratorPipeline
description: DAG and route-card schema for L0 Skill & MCP tier orchestration (L1-L5). scripts/validate_pipeline.py enforces this shape plus the safety rules; tests/test_validator.py fails if the two drift apart.

scope.description: Concise summary of the global user goal.

macro_mode.description: True if a domain pipeline is nested inside a tier via sub_pipeline.

entry_tier.description: First tier that still has to run after inspecting user-supplied artifacts.

satisfied_tiers.description: Tiers the user already supplied (e.g. a finished script). They precede entry_tier and are not listed in tiers.

ambient_modifiers.description: L0-Ambient skills bound to the whole session (tone, brevity, design rules).

approved_budget_usd.description: Total spend the user pre-approved in the route card. Paid tiers whose cumulative estimate fits inside it may use gate 'auto'.

max_retries.description: How many times a faulty node may be re-run before escalating to the user.

gate.description: auto = proceed; cost_confirm = ask unless within approved_budget_usd; high_risk_confirm = always ask.

role.description: Functional role of this tier in the current task.

tools.description: Skill names or MCP tool identifiers assigned to this tier.

node_id.description: Optional unique node identifier for node-level checkpointing and DAG dependencies.

fallback.description: Optional fallback tools if primary tools are unavailable.

depends_on.description: Upstream tiers (planned or satisfied) or node ids that must pass handshake before this tier starts.

estimated_cost_usd.description: Estimated spend of this tier in USD. Required when gate is cost_confirm or when a paid tool runs under gate auto.

expected_output.description: Verifiable output contract required by downstream tiers.

rollback_target.description: Upstream tier to re-run if this tier fails validation.

sub_pipeline.description: Nested micro-pipeline compressed into this tier. Its gates and costs bubble up.
